findings.title: First Contentful Paint
findings.problem: The first visible content is taking 4.4 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.
findings.fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint
findings.problem: The main visible content is taking 5.1 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.
findings.fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

findings.title: Speed Index
findings.problem: Visible page content is appearing slowly (5.7 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.
findings.fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

findings.title: Network dependency tree
findings.problem: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.
findings.fix: [Avoid chaining critical requests](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/network-dependency-tree) by reducing the length of chains, reducing the download size of resources, or deferring the download of unnecessary resources to improve page load.

findings.title: Time to Interactive
findings.problem: Lighthouse reported 7.8 s for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.
findings.fix: Time to Interactive is the amount of time it takes for the page to become fully interactive. [Learn more about the Time to Interactive metric](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/interactive/).

findings.title: Minify CSS
findings.problem: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 11 KiB for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.
findings.fix: Minifying CSS files can reduce network payload sizes. [Learn how to minify CSS](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unminified-css/).

findings.title: Minimize main-thread work
findings.problem: Lighthouse reported 3.9 s for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.
findings.fix: Consider reducing the time spent parsing, compiling and executing JS. You may find delivering smaller JS payloads helps with this. [Learn how to minimize main-thread work](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/mainthread-work-breakdown/)

findings.title: Image elements do not have explicit `width` and `height`
findings.problem: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.
findings.fix: Set an explicit width and height on image elements to reduce layout shifts and improve CLS. [Learn how to set image dimensions](https://web.dev/articles/optimize-cls#images_without_dimensions)

findings.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
findings.problem: Some text does not have enough contrast against its background, making it difficult for users to read.
findings.fix: Increase the contrast between foreground and background colors and verify the result against WCAG contrast requirements.

findings.title: Links do not have a discernible name
findings.problem: One or more links do not have a clear accessible name.
findings.fix: Give every meaningful link descriptive visible text or an appropriate accessible name.

findings.title: Touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing.
findings.problem: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.
findings.fix: Touch targets with sufficient size and spacing help users who may have difficulty targeting small controls to activate the targets. [Learn more about touch targets](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/target-size).

findings.title: Document does not have a main landmark.
findings.problem: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.
findings.fix: One main landmark helps screen reader users navigate a web page. [Learn more about landmarks](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/landmark-one-main).

findings.title: Page is blocked from indexing
findings.problem: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.
findings.fix: Search engines are unable to include your pages in search results if they don't have permission to crawl them. [Learn more about crawler directives](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/is-crawlable/).

findings.problem: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
Ensure the document has a main landmark
Ensure all page content is contained by landmarks

findings.title: Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order
findings.problem: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.
findings.fix: Properly ordered headings that do not skip levels convey the semantic structure of the page, making it easier to navigate and understand when using assistive technologies. [Learn more about heading order](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/heading-order).

findings.problem: Ensure the order of headings is semantically correct

findings.title: LCP breakdown
findings.problem: Lighthouse identified an issue with this page.
findings.fix: Each [subpart has specific improvement strategies](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/lcp-breakdown). Ideally, most of the LCP time should be spent on loading the resources, not within delays.

findings.title: Avoid multiple page redirects
findings.problem: Lighthouse reported Est savings of 1,600 ms for this audit, indicating that this check did not meet the recommended threshold.
findings.fix: Redirects introduce additional delays before the page can be loaded. [Learn how to avoid page redirects](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/redirects/).

findings.title: Reduce unused CSS
findings.problem: The page is downloading resources that are not fully used during the initial page load. This increases network and processing work.
findings.fix: Remove unused code, split CSS and JavaScript by page or feature, defer non-critical resources, and load assets only when they are needed.

findings.title: Document does not have a meta description
findings.problem: The page does not have a useful meta description that summarizes its content for search engines.
findings.fix: Add a unique, concise meta description describing the page and its main value to users.

findings.title: Forced reflow

findings.fix: A forced reflow occurs when JavaScript queries geometric properties (such as offsetWidth) after styles have been invalidated by a change to the DOM state.
